def VTask.cons {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {δ : α → Sort u_2} (m : Multiset α) (a : α) (b : δ a) (f : (a : α) → a ∈ m → δ a) (a' : α) (h : a' ∈ a ::ₘ m) : δ a' := by
  have h_main : δ a' := by
    by_cases h₁ : a' = a
    · -- Case: a' = a
      subst h₁
      exact b
    · -- Case: a' ≠ a
      have h₂ : a' ∈ m := by
        simp only [Multiset.mem_cons, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
        tauto
      exact f a' h₂
  exact h_main
